description: Maximum height of each turbine, from mean sea level to rotor tip.
context_quote: The maximum height of each turbine is proposed to range from 591 to 617 feet (ft) (180 to 188 meters [m]), measured from mean sea level (MSL) to rotor tip.

description: Distance between the two turbines.
context_quote: The turbines will be sited approximately 3,445 ft (1,050 m) apart in a north south orientation.

description: Diameter of the MP/TP foundation at the seabed.
context_quote: The diameter of the MP/TP foundation at the seabed is approximately 26.2 ft (8 m)

description: Length of the monopile.
context_quote: Depending on the specific depth of installation, the length of the monopile will be between 164 ft to 197 ft (50 m to 60 m)

description: Radius of the preinstalled filter layer of crushed rock material.
context_quote: The scour protection system will consist of a preinstalled filter layer of crushed rock material deployed in a radius of approximately 72.2 ft (22 m)

description: Height of the preinstalled filter layer of crushed rock material.
context_quote: and a height of about 2.6 ft (0.8 m) at each foundation location

description: Radius of the armor layer of crushed rock material.
context_quote: The armor layer consists of crushed rock material weighing between 88.2 lb to 440.9 lb (40 kg and 200 kg), installed in a radius of approximately 39.4 ft (12 m)

description: Height of the armor layer of crushed rock material.
context_quote: and a height of about 4.9 ft (1.5 m) around each foundation.

description: Monopile penetration depth.
context_quote: driven to the design penetration depth of 98 ft to 105 ft (30 m to 32 m)

description: Width of the Export Cable right-of-way.
context_quote: As approved in the RAP, the Export Cable will be located within a 200-ft (61-m) wide right-of-way (ROW).

description: Target burial depth for the Export Cable.
context_quote: The target depth of burial for the Export Cable remains approximately 6.6 ft (2 m), as previously approved in the RAP.

description: If the Export Cable target burial depth is not met, additional protection must be provided.
context_quote: As approved in the RAP, in locations where actual target depths are not met, additional protection, such as placement of rock berms or concrete mattresses, may be employed to ensure that adequate cable protection is provided.

description: Temporary construction right-of-way width for onshore cable installation.
context_quote: Dominion proposes a 30 ft (9.1 m) temporary construction right-of-way along the entirety of the route for installation of the cable.

description: Permanent easement width for onshore cable access during operation.
context_quote: Upon completion of construction, 15 ft (4.6 m) will be retained as a permanent easement for access during operation.

description: Minimum burial depth for onshore cables.
geographic_scope: Onshore Interconnection Cable and Fiber Optic Cable
context_quote: buried to a minimum depth of 3.3 ft (1 m)

description: Distance between separate boreholes for the onshore interconnection cable and fiber optic cable.
geographic_scope: Onshore Interconnection Cable and Fiber Optic Cable boreholes
context_quote: The Onshore Interconnection Cable and Fiber Optic Cable will be installed in separate boreholes approximately 3 ft (0.9 m) apart

description: Deployment duration of the metocean buoy.
source_section_number: Description of the Proposed CVOW Modifications
context_quote: The buoy will remain in place for less than 1 year.

description: Diameter of the metocean buoy.
source_section_number: Description of the Proposed CVOW Modifications
context_quote: Depending on the selected buoy type, its diameter will be 1.6 to 4.9 ft (0.5 to 1.5 m).

description: Mooring scope radius of the metocean buoy.
source_section_number: Description of the Proposed CVOW Modifications
context_quote: Based on a standard mooring configuration at a water depth of approximately 83.6 ft (25.5 m MLLW), the mooring scope will have a radius of 180 ft (55 m).

description: The Export Cable ROW cannot be moved or expanded beyond the limits of the previously surveyed corridor.
context_quote: If Dominion determines that a change is necessary, the ROW will not be moved or expanded beyond the limits of the previously surveyed 984 ft (300 m) corridor.

description: Pile driving activities will occur during daylight hours only.
context_quote: As approved in the RAP, pile driving activities will occur during daylight hours only, starting approximately 30 minutes after dawn and ending approximately 30 minutes prior to dusk, unless a situation arises where ceasing the pile driving activity would compromise safety (both human health and environmental) and/or the integrity of the Project.
